hero.lede: Masab is testing a simpler way to arrange home nursing. When the app launches, patients and nurses will be able to manage the visit in one place, in Arabic or English.
hero.note: The Masab app is in testing. Launch details will be shared here.
hero.caption: Illustrative app preview · Sample interface data

difference.eyebrow: A BETTER WAY TO ARRANGE CARE
difference.intro: Finding care can mean calls, referrals and waiting for an answer. Masab is being designed to bring the details of a home nursing visit into one straightforward flow.
difference.challenge1: Call around to find an available nurse
difference.challenge2: Ask for rates one conversation at a time
difference.challenge3: Wait for updates about the visit
difference.challenge4: Keep track of completed visits yourself
difference.approach1: Send a request to nurses offering that care
difference.approach2: Review the price before you confirm
difference.approach4: Close the visit with a completion code

how.intro: As the app moves through testing, this is the six-step visit flow being prepared for patients and nurses.
how.deadline: Reply and payment windows are set for each booking. If a deadline passes, the request closes or the held slot is released.

steps.title: Request
steps.text: Choose the service, time, duration and address.

steps.title: Accept
steps.text: A matching nurse accepts or declines before the reply deadline.

steps.title: Pay
steps.text: After acceptance, pay through the Masab wallet before its deadline.

steps.title: On my way
steps.text: Your nurse lets you know when they set off.

steps.title: Start
steps.text: Confirm the booking number together at the door.

steps.title: Complete
steps.text: Share your completion code to close the visit.

patients.intro: When Masab launches, families will be able to choose the care they need, compare nurse profiles and follow a visit as it moves forward, all in one place.
features: Choose a service, date, duration and address
See nurses who offer that care and are on shift
Compare profiles, experience, languages and rates
See the full price before sending your request
Pay from your wallet after a nurse accepts
Review requested, upcoming, ongoing and completed visits
Chat privately and get updates as the visit progresses
patients.walletText: Top up and review payments for each visit in the app.
patients.sample: Sample names and rates from the brochure

nurses.intro: Masab is being tested as a place for nurses to present their experience, set up the services they offer and manage requests around their availability.

features.title: Build a professional profile
features.text: Add license, education, experience, languages and references.

features.title: Choose how you work
features.text: Set the services, rates and shifts you offer.

features.title: Review complete requests
features.text: See service, hours, area and price before you decide.

features.title: Keep visits organized
features.text: Use your schedule and wallet to follow bookings and earnings.

features.title: Travel with clarity
features.text: Payment is confirmed before travel; chat stays in the app.

nurses.accountText: Nurses can also use the same account to book care for themselves.
nurses.sample: Example request data from the brochure
nurses.orbit: Built for the work you do

online.intro: Online consultations are a proposed next step for care that can happen by video, helping patients connect with a nurse beyond their immediate area.
online.detail: The planned flow lets patients choose home or online care. Nurses can set a separate online rate, with video, chat and photos kept in the app.
online.callMessage: Can you move the camera closer to the dressing?
online.question: What do you need?
online.preview: Preview of the planned online booking and video call

trust.eyebrow: TRUST IS PART OF THE VISIT
trust.intro: A home visit is personal. These are the trust principles guiding Masab's design as the app moves through testing.

principles.title: Verified nurses
principles.text: Professional profiles include license, education, experience and references.

principles.title: Two-way check
principles.text: Confirm the booking number at the door and share a code to finish the visit.

principles.title: Private chat
principles.text: Keep communication inside the platform, with contact details protected.

principles.title: Always informed
principles.text: Get notifications at key moments in the booking journey.

principles.title: Arabic & English
principles.text: Move between languages, with right-to-left Arabic layouts supported.

principles.title: Private by design
principles.text: People see their own bookings; visit photos stay with the patient and nurse involved.

trust.adminTitle: One place to support every visit.
trust.adminText: Planned admin tools bring booking activity, system notifications, patient and nurse support chat, service rules, account review and appeals together.
trust.roadmapText: These features are part of the proposed roadmap and are not available yet.

closing.lede: Bringing trusted nursing care closer to home.
closing.status: The app is being tested. Download links will be shared at launch.
closing.footnote: Official app links will appear here when available.

footer.about: Home nursing, brought into one thoughtful platform for patients and nurses.
footer.tagline: Built around care, clarity and connection.
